sentences.text: **Scheme Brief Description:** The scheme "Financial Assistance for Cremation" by the Bihar Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, Labour Resources Department, Government of Bihar, provides financial assistance of ₹5,000/-to the dependents of the deceased worker for performing cremation.
**Who is this for:** Individual; Category: Social welfare & Empowerment; Sector: Financial assistance

**Detailed Description:** The scheme "Financial Assistance for Cremation" by the Bihar Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, Labour Resources Department, Government of Bihar, provides financial assistance of ₹5,000/-to the dependents of the deceased worker for performing cremation.
**Benefits / Assistance:** Financial Assistance of ₹5,000/- is provided for the cremation of the deceased construction worker.

**Application Process:** &gt; **Application** **Step 1:****** Visit the [Official Website ](https://bocw.bihar.gov.in/Website/SchemeApply.aspx)of the Bihar Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board. **Step 2:** Click on &amp;quot;[Scheme Application](https://bocw.bihar.gov.in/Website/SchemeApply.aspx)&amp;quot; and select &amp;quot;[Apply for Scheme](https://bocw.bihar.gov.in/Registration/SchemeTaggingWeb.aspx)&amp;quot;. **Step 3:****** Enter your registration number and click &amp;quot;Show&amp;quot; to view your details. **Step 4:****** Select the scheme you intend to apply for, enter all mandatory information and upload the necessary documents in the specified format and size. **Step 6:****** Click on &amp;quot;Submit Application&amp;quot; to complete the process. &gt; **Application Tracking** Applicants can track their application status online on the [official website ](https://bocw.bihar.gov.in/Registration/ApplicationStatus.aspx)of the Board by providing their registration number.
**Contacts & Authorities:** Nodal Department: Building Construction Department
**Tags:** Construction, Building, Labour, Financial Assistance, Worker, Death
